title: Which country speaks it officially: Asia
intro: Find a country in Asia that uses each language officially.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Persian as an official language?
questions.explain: Persian is an official language of Iran (Islamic Republic of).

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Filipino as an official language?
questions.explain: Filipino is an official language of Philippines.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Dzongkha as an official language?

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Mongolian as an official language?

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Tamil as an official language?
